verification.root_cause: the manifest PI walk reduced EVERY curve to a tangent free arc: it derived PIs from the stroked pieces, and for a curve group adjoined by spirals it intersected the spirals' CHORD segments — a chord PI sits inside the true tangent PI by half the spiral deflection, and VertexCurve had no spiral member anyway, so the builder wrote SpiralIn/FixedArc/SpiralOut (2x, 50 m clothoids, r=200) as one free arc of the chord-solved radius: built decode length 1840.579 vs oracle decode 1841.760028 (-1.18 m). The one-arc choice happened in the BUILDER (no SCS member in its curve translation), not in the writers
verification.fix: analyze: alignment_curve_groups() classifies the element run into groups (SpiralIn/FixedArc/SpiralOut triples or the writers' single FreeSpiralCurveSpiral, lone arcs, lines); when EVERY group is an SCS, element_scs_walk() replaces the stroked walk: the chain-ordered elements' fixed lines give the exact tangent lines, the PIs are their intersections (ROAD1: 4 vertices, PI1 = 4523.529999994164, 3997.8399999934295 — the design PI), and each group carries {kind:scs, spiral_in, radius, spiral_out} from the record (SpiralIn.length/radius, SpiralOut.length). build: curves[i] kind scs writes VertexCurve::SpiralCurveSpiral at that inner vertex. Alignments with arc-only or mixed groups keep the stroked walk bit-for-bit (XC_STORM: unchanged, 3 vertices, [null])
